# Medicare Program; CY 2026 Revisions to Payment Policies Under the Physician Fee Schedule

**A Rule by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services on 11/15/2025**

Agency: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).

Document Number: 2025-12345

Publication Date: November 15, 2025

Effective Date: January 1, 2026

Comment Period End: December 31, 2025

Final Rule

## SUMMARY

This final rule updates the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule payment policies and payment rates for services furnished under the PFS on or after January 1, 2026. Specifically, this rule:

- Updates the conversion factor for CY 2026 based on statutory updates.
- Revises the methodology used to determine practice expense relative value units.
- Finalizes payment policies for telehealth services beyond the COVID-19 public health emergency.
- Implements new HCPCS codes for remote patient monitoring services.
- Extends the incident-to supervision flexibility for certain behavioral health services.

## DATES

The provisions of this final rule are effective January 1, 2026. Comments on the information collection requirements must be received no later than December 31, 2025.

## ADDRESSES

In commenting, refer to file code CMS-1807-F. Electronic comments may be submitted at https://www.regulations.gov.

## List of Subjects

This rule amends 42 CFR Part 410 and 42 CFR Part 414. Additional conforming changes appear at 45 CFR Part 170.
